description_en: Lists the details of database partitions in a data lake
description_zh: 获取数据湖中数据库分区详情列表
name: ListPartitions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data catalog
parameters.name: catalog_id

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page of results. This token is returned in the response. For the first request, pass an empty string
parameters.help_zh: 翻页token，从返回结果返回，无则传空字符串或''
parameters.name: next_page_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The maximum value is 1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The list of partition values. You can provide a partial list of values to query the names of all sub-partitions
parameters.help_zh: 分区值列表，可以只传入部分分区的值，会查询出所有下级分区的分区名
parameters.name: partial_part_values

parameters.help_en: The name of the data table
parameters.name: table_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to share the column information in the storage descriptor (SD) of the partition. Valid values:

true: Shares the partition column information in the SD. This way, identical columns are returned only once. This reduces network traffic and improves the performance of this API operation.

false: Does not share the information
parameters.help_zh:
是否共享partition中的SD中的column信息。取值如下：

true：共享SD中的partition columns信息，这样相同的columns只会返回一份数据，就能降低网络传输，提高这个接口的性能。

false：不共享
parameters.name: is_share_sd
